Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine attached approved deck builder screenshot. Preserve exact navy mountain background, weathered brass design, 16:9 composition, full card illustrations, two horizontally grouped mat categories, six cards per row, compact setup thumbnails, all core placement and font styling. Make these precise functional edits:
1 Remove word "copies" beneath EVERY mat card. Each control is simply a minus button, plain numeral, plus button: "- 3 +", "- 2 +", red "- 4 +" for existing overlimit. Keep Compare checkboxes below.
2 All LEFT COLLECTION row numbers are now deck quantities, NOT gold cost. Remove ALL round gold coin backgrounds from collection row numbers only. Use plain WHITE numerals. Add a small minus button immediately left of each number, existing plus immediately right. Collection rows should have clear thumbnail/name on left and aligned "- 0 +" on right. Explicit small column caption "In deck". Use 0 for Asahina Artisan, Doji Challenger, Doji Courtier, Doji Whisperer, Matsu Berserker, Shiba Guardian; 4 for Doji Magistrate; 3 for Gold Mine, Marketplace, Dojo Grounds, Library of Secrets. Keep numbers on actual card faces unchanged. Keep Gold filter.
3 Move the bottom-right "Compare selected (0)" action to the mat toolbar immediately right of the "Mat | List" pills, shorten button label to "Compare (0)" and disabled appearance. Remove old bottom-right Compare and Clear entirely. Keep card size slider on far right without overlap; compress toolbar Group/Sort widths as needed. No stale duplicate action.
4 Replace standalone left panel heading COLLECTION with neat inline tab selectors "Collection" active and "Setup" inactive. This consumes no more height than old heading. Top "Change setup" remains as second entry point to same Setup view. No extra sidebar.
5 Keep footer simple "46 Dynasty cards · 40 minimum · 1 copy warning" and "Draft can still be saved".
Keep all other design unchanged. Small footer "Concept · illustrative cards". This is a user-reviewed mockup, not new game rules.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create companion in-game screenshot of attached approved Legend of Five Rings Emperor deck builder in SETUP editing mode. Preserve its navy cloth and dark-gold mountain background, ivory readable fonts, sparse aged brass borders, top DECK BUILDER header, name 'Crane — Court & Steel', Save draft enabled and My decks. Same slim setup summary row with tiny thumbnails labeled Stronghold, Border Keep, Bamboo Harvesters and visible Dynasty46/Fate40 tabs at top. No decorative clan sidebar.
At left the compact functional panel has two tab headings Collection | Setup with Setup selected. Below a Clan dropdown 'Crane', then three compact selectable categories 'Stronghold', 'Border Keep', 'Bamboo Harvesters', each with tiny current thumbnail and a checkmark if chosen. Stronghold active. Bottom of this small panel says 'Choose one of each. Kept outside both decks.' Use rest of left panel for a concise setup explanation, not clutter.
Main area to right replaces the usual card mat with a spacious SINGLE-SELECTION card chooser titled 'CHOOSE YOUR STRONGHOLD', small subtitle 'One Stronghold · Emperor Edition'. Three full portrait classic L5R-style Stronghold card faces side-by-side, named 'The Crane Stronghold', 'Sapphire Citadel', 'Windswept Pavilion' are illustrative layout placeholders. Cards approx 230px wide, art of Crane castles, intact rules boxes, weathered elegant style. Beneath first: radio selected, 'Selected'; beneath others radio 'Choose this Stronghold'. A tiny printing/version dropdown beneath each. No plus/minus quantity controls here. Click another card replaces current choice. No cards added to Dynasty or Fate. In a modest bottom explanatory inset exactly: 'Border Keep: starts in play.' and 'Bamboo Harvesters: starts bowed for the second player only.' Then 'Starting cards do not count toward Dynasty or Fate totals.' Clear button 'Back to deck' at bottom right. Tiny footer 'Concept · illustrative choices; availability checked in game'. Top-level save remains accessible, no mandatory confirmation popup, no fake multiple stronghold selection. Keep setup thumbnails small in top row; large card display only belongs to this focused chooser. Polished screenshot, beautiful background subtly visible around and between cards. This illustrates the same editor's Setup category, not a separate game or faction chooser.

notes: Collection values are changed to draft quantities, not cosmetically stripped gold cost. Setup is one shared chooser accessed from left category or top summary; select one Stronghold and one version each starting Holding. Drafts may save while invalid. Real card identities, printing and playability require engine validation.
